summary: Nephros, Inc. filed an 8-K on October 13, 2026, announcing its 2026 Annual Meeting for November 25, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. Eastern, to be held virtually, with a September 30, 2026 record date. The meeting date moves more than 30 days from the June 16, 2025 anniversary, resetting Rule 14a-8 shareholder proposal and Rule 14a-19 universal proxy nomination deadlines to October 23, 2026. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation on a special situation is disclosed; this is a routine meeting-notice current report, classified as None. Watch for proxy content and any nomination contest.
